authority.source: Proposed formalization; placeholder definitions await owner review.

scope: Declared ordered event observations; example definitions are placeholders.

trace.order: authoritative recorded event order, including rejections and retries
trace.projection: retain each recorded event without sorting, merging or deduplication
trace.model: placeholder composed model; execution membership is unproved
trace.environment: placeholder capabilities; no omitted actor is implicitly excluded
trace.initialization: separate initial-state check, including zero-operation executions
trace.continuity: requires post/pre correspondence at every retained boundary

Loss.clause: uncompensated vault loss is present before or after the event
Loss.definition: PLACEHOLDER one-asset policy: D(q) := v(q)+p(q)<v0+c(q); Loss := D(pre) or D(post). p counts independently justified entitlement discharges, never approval alone. v0=10, integer asset units. Other assets, valuation and allowed losses await review.

readings.body: forall sigma in Traces: always(not Loss())
readings.intuitive: no admitted operation sequence reaches uncompensated vault loss
readings.plain: no admitted operation sequence drains the vault

fixtures.note: v0=10,c=0; v=7,p=3 offsets the withdrawal; initial D checked separately.
v0=10,c=0; v=7,p=0 is a loss, including a partial drain.
D(pre) is already true; no-operation initialization remains a separate obligation.
